rows: 头骨内部
起点位于大型头骨内部，右侧有出口。
出口通向前期庭园流程。
下行水道
后续回到起点时可以沿水道向下探索。
与起步段分开看，避免把回访路线当成初次出口。
rowsEn: Inside the skull
The starting room lies inside a large skull, with an exit on the right.
This exit leads into the early garden route.
Descending water channel
A later revisit follows a water channel downward.
Distinguish the revisit from the initial departure.

rows: 前段帐篷
庭园前段有可以保存游戏的帐篷。
以帐篷作为回查支路和补给的参照。
泡泡与高台
泡泡附近存在高处平台及上下层路线。
对照地图的高低层，不把看到的亮点混作同一种收集物。
园丁所在路段
前期油瓶教学之后会遭遇园丁。
后续流程转向猎人小屋；箭头表示流程衔接，不是精确出口坐标。
rowsEn: Early tent
A save tent is available in the early garden.
Use it as a reference for supplies and branch revisits.
Bubbles and raised platforms
Bubble rooms have higher platforms and routes on multiple levels.
Compare elevations on the map and distinguish the different pickups.
Groundskeeper segment
The encounter follows the early oil-bottle tutorial.
The subsequent route heads toward Hunter's Cabin; diagram arrows are not exact exit coordinates.

rows: 拾荒者所在路段
小屋内可与拾荒者交谈。
对话附近接续焰瓶教学，适合用作剧情定位点。
悬笼与泡泡
探索路段中有悬笼、泡泡和尖刺。
区分安全落脚点和刺面，不把所有可见高台都当成安全平台。
吊坠与庭园回访
小屋探索可取得猎人的吊坠，后续会回到庭园。
回访紫色障碍附近时重新核对当前已获得的操作能力。
rowsEn: Looter segment
Looter can be encountered in the cabin.
The nearby flaming-vessel tutorial provides a story landmark.
Cages and bubbles
The route includes hanging cages, bubbles and spikes.
Separate safe footholds from spike surfaces.
Pendant and garden revisit
The cabin route includes the Hunter's Pendant and a later garden revisit.
Check your available actions when returning to the purple obstacle.

rows: 浅黄色房间群
局部地图中浅黄色房间形成上下分支和横向回环。
先辨认当前人物标记，再核对已探索的通道。
紫色帐篷标记
地图画面可见多个紫色节点；录像也有帐篷存档提示。
用已经到过的帐篷定位回程，不据截图推断完整帐篷数量。
竖井与高处支路
探索路上有入口竖井和需要攀升的支路。
普通攀爬受耐力限制，应辨认可站立的平台。
伊尔达与营地
巨大车轮背景的平台和篝火营地均出现伊尔达。
这是同一 NPC 的不同到访节点。
rowsEn: Pale-yellow rooms
The partial map shows vertical branches and horizontal loops.
Locate the player marker before comparing explored passages.
Purple tent markers
Several purple nodes appear; save-tent scenes are also recorded.
Use visited tents for orientation, not to infer the total tent count.
Shafts and higher branches
The route includes an entrance shaft and climbing branches.
Ordinary Climb uses stamina; identify solid resting platforms.
Ilda and the campsite
Ilda appears by a large wheel backdrop and later at a campfire.
These are different visits to the same NPC.

rows: 入口水道
管道、水流与纵向落差构成入口地形，侧边有小平台。
检查侧边凹槽，不把入口竖井理解为只能直落到底。
气流竖井
窄平台位于竖向气流中，底部及边缘有尖刺。
使用气流移动前确认相关能力；按中继平台分辨层次。
柳儿与紫色帐篷
柳儿出现在带蜡烛的横向平台，另有紫色帐篷补给节点。
分别作为人物定位和补给定位，不据此补写任务完成状态。
rowsEn: Entrance waterway
Pipes and water frame a vertical descent with small side platforms.
Check side recesses rather than assuming a direct drop to the bottom.
Updraft shaft
Narrow platforms sit in an updraft above and beside spikes.
Check the required ability and use intermediate platforms to identify levels.
Willow and the purple tent
Willow appears on a candle-lit platform; a purple tent provides supplies.
Use these as character and supply landmarks without assuming quest completion.

rows: 浅色分叉与左侧红色区域
局部地图右端为当前人物位置，左侧还显示其他颜色的房间。
按区域颜色与已走过的房间区分章节，不把整张画面都算作墓谷。
吊钟与虚线平台
吊钟附近有透明或虚线标出的平台，周围可见尖刺。
机关变化前后应分别核对；虚线不代表当前可站立地面。
王冠舞台与吊笼
木制舞台有王冠装饰，附近有吊笼与角色对话。
舞台会再次回访，场景状态可能发生变化。
反锁连接的回访
回访段落来到反锁通道另一侧，斜板和平台连接地形。
区分已开启捷径与初次到访状态。
rowsEn: Pale branches and red rooms to the left
The player marker is on the right; differently coloured rooms appear to the left.
Separate regions by colour and explored rooms, not by the whole screenshot.
Bell and outlined platforms
The bell area includes transparent or outlined platforms and spikes.
Check mechanism state; an outline is not necessarily a usable foothold.
Crowned stage and cages
A crowned wooden stage has nearby cages and dialogue scenes.
The stage is revisited and its state can change.
Locked connection revisit
A later visit reaches the other side of a locked passage with sloping boards.
Distinguish opened shortcuts from the first-visit state.

rows: 紫色帐篷
城堡内部的紫色帐篷有明确存档提示。
以此定位支路回程和补给。
链条与高处书页
链条机关房间左上方可见书页，部分墙面和平台带刺。
辨认安全高台和刺面；书页所属故事需以书页菜单确认。
月亮背景的上下层
上层独立平台有尖刺，下层存在连续地面。
下层出口与高处支路分开检查，避免把可见上层当作安全落脚点。
rowsEn: Purple tent
A save confirmation appears at the castle's purple tent.
Use it to orient branch returns and supply stops.
Chains and a high page
A page is visible at the upper left of a chain-mechanism room with spikes.
Identify safe platforms; confirm the storybook through its menu.
Levels against a moon backdrop
Raised platforms have spikes while the lower level has continuous ground.
Check lower exits separately from higher branches.

rows: 浅紫色房间群
局部地图显示多条上下分叉，人物标记位于右侧。
按当前房间回查邻接支路；黑色部分不代表已经清空。
紫色帐篷
木台上的帐篷有存档提示；深渊探索前也有回到帐篷的段落。
用已经到过的帐篷确定补给和回访位置。
巴吉的圆窗房间
房间内有圆窗与救生圈，初次和回访都能见到巴吉。
作为船员线索的定位点，不自动等同于载具已经开放。
吊网与反锁连接
高空通道交错分布吊网和刺球，回程涉及反锁连接。
捷径开启前后的回程不同，注意当前通道状态。
rowsEn: Pale-purple rooms
The partial map shows vertical branches and a player marker on the right.
Review adjacent branches; black areas are not evidence of completion.
Purple tent
A tent on a wooden platform confirms saving; it is revisited before the Deep segment.
Use visited tents to identify supply and return points.
Barge's round-window room
A round window and life ring identify Barge's room on both visits.
This crew-related landmark does not by itself confirm vessel access.
Nets and locked connections
High passages contain nets and spiked balls; the return involves a locked connection.
Check whether the shortcut has been opened.

rows: 水下载具通道
窄洞、台阶和上下水道构成载具探索地形。
依据小地图的连通关系辨认出口，照明之外不一定可通行。
尖刺侧道
一处被尖刺包围的侧道显示饰物点获取提示。
可以确定槽位拾取存在，不能由单个点推算区域总数。
巨大头骨背景
载具经过大型头骨左侧的横向通道。
将头骨作为场景定位地标，而非新的区域名称。
陆地战斗与篝火
后续有徒步战斗和巴吉、船员同场的篝火对话。
水下与陆上操作场景要区分；对话聚集不代表成就自动完成。
rowsEn: Vessel passages
Narrow caves, steps and vertical waterways form the vessel route.
Use the minimap connections; unlit space is not necessarily passable.
Spiked side passage
A spiked branch shows a trinket-slot pickup message.
This confirms one pickup, not the region's total.
Large skull backdrop
The vessel passes horizontally along the left of a large skull.
Use the skull as a landmark, not a new region name.
Land fight and campfire
Later scenes include an on-foot fight and a campfire with Barge and the crew.
Distinguish land and vessel sections; the gathering is not an achievement confirmation.
